decisions.reason: Requiring a rationale for proposed question removals does not change the required or optional layers of retained-question answers.
The removal-rationale rule does not alter how international perspectives are integrated into the manuscript.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY requiring proposed removals to be made in suggesting mode with an explanatory comment, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The rationale required for removing existing questions does not change the AI chapter's mandatory status, content, or length guidance.
The existing-question removal rationale does not change the candidate-questions chapter's subject or length guidance.
The curation documentation rule does not alter the content focus or length policy for the first-time leader chapter.
The requirement to explain proposed question removals does not change the pre-interview preparation deliverable or its content and length guidance.
The removal-rationale rule does not alter the remote and hybrid leadership chapter's subject or length guidance.
Question-removal rationale documentation is unrelated to the formats and types of companion learning assets.
Explaining why questions are proposed for removal does not change the 110,000-word ceiling or the recorded approximate existing word count.
The question-curation rationale rule does not change the production-readiness standard for companion templates.
The question-removal rationale requirement does not affect the video-script deliverable or recording responsibility.
